query_normalized: predicting gut microbiome response to dietary interventions using publicly available data biology
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (a) and (b) as it explicitly models the relationship between dietary intake (the independent variable) and microbiome composition to predict phenotypic outcomes, directly addressing the core mechanism of predicting microbiome response to dietary interventions. Additionally, it serves as a foundational methodological reference (d) for the specific statistical challenge of handling high-dimensional compositional data in this domain.
